olivia_cs: Heads-up  Lotus Labs dry-run hit three quick blockers: telemetry egress, KMS grants, and CloudTrail forwarding. Dropping notes so we can patch the runbook before cutover.
dan_net: what error did they see?
olivia_cs: their infra added an outbound rule to internal-only netblock so telemetry requests timed out. they ran:
```
# customer applied
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0x --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.0.0.0/8
```
dan_net: we should add 2 options: (A) recommended public CIDR example (e.g., 203.0.113.0/24) or (B) VPC endpoint/private link snippet. will add a verify curl in runbook.
marta_sec: KMS: their role has wildcard `kms:*`  security flagged it. runbook needs least-priv example and note about `kms:CreateGrant` for temporary creds. also add rotation note: quarterly default, monthly requires maintenance.
ryan_platform: minimal policy we can drop in:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:222333444555:key/lotus-key"}]}
```
marta_sec: CloudTrail forward failed with AccessDenied to central bucket. runbook currently says "enable CloudTrail"  too vague. need cross-account PutObject + PutObjectAcl policy snippet and prereqs: SSE, Object Lock >=1y, block public access. common failures: encryption mismatch, missing PutObjectAcl.
deploy-bot: Runbook checklist updated: added "Telemetry CIDR or PrivateLink", "KMS least-priv example", "CloudTrail cross-account policy". Link: /runbooks/lotus-priv-dryrun (draft).
olivia_cs: Next steps: dan to add network snippets + verify, marta to add KMS rationale + rotation impact, ryan to PR runbook edits. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Lotus infra tomorrow 09:30 PT. Tagging account renewal_watch if they require monthly rotation without a maintenance SLA.
dan_net: will post terraform and curl verify in PR.
ryan_platform: PR by EOD. will include one-liner to check grants: `aws kms list-grants --key-id <id>`.
marta_sec: I'll add a short troubleshooting checklist for CloudTrail AccessDenied.
olivia_cs: thanks all 44d i'll send the invite and close loop after second dry-run.
